action_summary: Added 4-view flip test-time augmentation to the prediction step: the test set is passed through the loaded Xception checkpoint as the original image, horizontal flip, vertical flip and both flips (the same symmetries used as training augmentation), and the sigmoid outputs are averaged and clipped to [0,1] before writing submission.csv. This reduces prediction variance for a single-model pipeline and should raise mean per-label AUC. Also disabled the activation-visualization call (plot only) to save inference runtime. Paths, data pipeline, batch size, target size and submission format are unchanged.
